question: When the frozen C10.62b transfer is expressed in the exact neutral-charge variable rather than the Y=(delta,theta/k) norm, does the regular long-wave charge direction approach unit transfer as k->0, and does a regular theta=O(k^2) velocity seed leak into charge only at O(k^2)?
fixed_subspace: C10.62b ordinary trajectory fixed, so Delta psi_pref=0 and I_khr=delta/(1+w)

frozen_reconstruction.w_of_a: r*t/[x*(1+t)] with x=x0/a^3, s=hypot(1,sqrt(lambda_D)*x), r=x/s, t=x/(s+1)

preregistered_diagnostics: For each unique lambda_HL, verify the three M_c duplicates give identical T_Y within 1e-12 absolute difference.
For each unique lambda_HL, compute R_Q on the three lowest k values and test whether |R_Q-1| decreases strictly as k decreases.
Fit a log-log slope p_Q of |R_Q-1| versus k on the three lowest k values when all deviations are nonzero.
For each unique lambda_HL, compute |L_QU| on the same three k values and test whether it decreases strictly as k decreases.
Fit a log-log slope p_U of |L_QU| versus k on the three lowest k values when all values are nonzero.
Record the dominant singular-vector alignment in Y only as a coordinate diagnostic; do not use it as the charge-retention criterion.

classification_rule.pass_scoped: All values finite, M_c duplication invariance <=1e-12, and for every lambda_HL both |R_Q-1| and |L_QU| approach zero monotonically over the frozen three-point low-k set, with p_Q>1.5 and p_U>1.5.
classification_rule.inconclusive_scoped: Finite and M_c-invariant, but one or more asymptotic trend/slope conditions fail.
classification_rule.technical_fail: Nonfinite values, malformed parent transfer, or M_c duplication mismatch >1e-12.

non_claims: not a full photon+baryon+UR adiabatic/isocurvature classification
not a proof that finite observational k modes are stable
not a UV/pre-EFT charge boundary prescription
